verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents a check-deposit service in which checks are mailed directly to your bank of deposit. That implies the physical check goes to the bank, and the docs state additional fees apply. The actual terms the story asks for are not published in the evidence: no fee amounts, no list of supported banks, and no turnaround time. Missing for 10: supported-bank list, specific per-deposit fee amounts, published turnaround time, explicit statement of check custody/disposition, independent corroboration.
